result.instructions: Tools for MemberSpace, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many paid members does my site have, and how many joined this month?"; "Which memberships expire in the next 30 days?"; "Who redeemed the SPRING20 coupon, and on which plan?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MemberSpace data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run memberspace_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run memberspace_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run memberspace_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. memberspace_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: memberspace_list_sites
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: Get the site that this Admin API key can access: name, subdomain, domain, currency, locale, and member counts (active, free, paid). Good first call to confirm the connection. MemberSpace API: GET /sites.

tools.name: memberspace_list_plans
tools.title: List plans
tools.description: List the site's membership plans (enabled or disabled; archived plans are never returned), with their type (free, oneTimePayment, multiPayment, subscription), pricing and content. MemberSpace API: GET /plans.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: memberspace_get_plan
tools.title: Get a plan
tools.description: Get one membership plan by its numeric id, including pricing, expiration rules and status. MemberSpace API: GET /plans/{id}.

tools.name: memberspace_list_memberships
tools.title: List memberships
tools.description: List member enrollments on plans, filtered by plan, member, status, and created, renewal or expiry dates. Use it for active subscriber counts, churn and renewal forecasts. MemberSpace API: GET /memberships.

created_after.description: Created on or after this time (inclusive).

renews_after.description: Current billing period ends on or after this time (inclusive).

renews_before.description: Current billing period ends before this time (exclusive).

expires_after.description: Expires on or after this time (inclusive).

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: memberspace_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List people who signed up on the site, filtered by id, exact name or email, status, a custom signup field answer, or creation date. Returns profile fields, not payment data. MemberSpace API: GET /members.

custom_signup_field_id.description: Custom field id (from memberspace_list_custom_fields). Use with custom_signup_field_value.

custom_signup_field_value.description: Only members whose answer to that field matches this value.

created_after.description: Created on or after this time (inclusive).

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: memberspace_list_member_events
tools.title: List member events
tools.description: List activity events recorded for members (for example account created, plan added, plan changed, log in, email sent). Filter by member, event type and time. MemberSpace API: GET /memberEvents.

event_types.description: Only events of these types, for example planAdded or logIn.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: memberspace_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom signup fields
tools.description: List the site's custom signup field definitions (label, type, required flag, which plans show it) and their ids. Use the ids with memberspace_list_members. MemberSpace API: GET /customSignupFields.

tools.name: memberspace_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: List the site's coupons: code, enabled flag, availability window, discount, plans limited to, and redemption counts. A code can match two coupons (one-time and subscription). MemberSpace API: GET /coupons.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: memberspace_list_coupon_redemptions
tools.title: List coupon redemptions
tools.description: List the members who redeemed one coupon, with the membership and plan each redemption applied to. MemberSpace API: GET /coupons/{couponId}/redemptions.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: memberspace_list_content_views
tools.title: List content views
tools.description: List records of members who viewed Content Library items successfully, with the member, the content item and the time. Filter by member, item or time. MemberSpace API: GET /contentLibrary/views.

node_id.description: Only views of this content item.

viewed_after.description: Viewed on or after this time (inclusive).

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

prompts.description: List the membership plans with their type and pricing. Open one plan for its expiration rules.

prompts.description: List the Content Library views by member, item or time. Use the results to see what members read.
